description: Source code implementing ubus (micro bus) support for hostapd, including functions for managing ubus connections, notifying events, handling BSS (Basic Service Set) operations, and integrating with the ubus messaging system within the OpenWRT platform.

classes.name: ubus_event_req
classes.description: Structure representing an asynchronous ubus notification request, including callback and response status.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_init
methods.description: Initializes ubus context and sets up connection, returns true if successful.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_ref_inc
methods.description: Increments the reference count for ubus context.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_ref_dec
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and frees ubus context if no longer used.

methods.name: hostapd_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a new BSS object to ubus for a given hostapd interface.

methods.name: hostapd_free_bss
methods.description: Removes and frees the ubus object associated with a hostapd BSS.

methods.name: hostapd_handle_event
methods.description: Handles a management frame event, notifying ubus subscribers.

methods.name: hostapd_notify
methods.description: Sends a notification to ubus subscribers with specified event type and data.

methods.name: hostapd_notify_authorized
methods.description: Notifies ubus about a station being authorized.

methods.name: hostapd_notify_beacon_report
methods.description: Notifies ubus about a beacon report event.

methods.name: hostapd_notify_bss_transition_response
methods.description: Sends a BSS transition response notification.

methods.name: hostapd_notify_bss_transition_query
methods.description: Sends a BSS transition query notification.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_handle_link_measurement
methods.description: Handles link measurement reports and notifies ubus.
